what_i_see: A flat gray rectangular hull-like base with a half-circle shape on one end (possibly an attempt at a bow or stern curve), topped by an orange/yellow raised rim or gunwale. Above it, a white flat rectangular panel elevated on a gray post, resembling a canopy or sail but looking more like a table or platform. The overall shape reads more like a desk lamp or food scale than a boat; the hull lacks tapering and the sail/mast structure is too blocky to convey a watercraft clearly.
